chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said:
"Stoning in the Qur'an is His, Exalted is He, saying: 'When the elderly man and the elderly woman commit zina, then stone them decisively, for they have fulfilled desire.'"

key_terms.الرَّجْمُ: stoning as a prescribed legal punishment
key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, cited here as the source being referenced
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina, meaning unlawful sexual intercourse
key_terms.فَارْجُمُوهُمَا: then stone the two of them

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam say about rajm in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to the Qur'an a wording concerning rajm for an elderly man and woman who commit zina. Its significance lies in its use within legal discussion on the hadd of zina and in debates related to Qur'anic wording and legal proof.
